info.title: Spectrum patient API
info.description: Same-origin API for the Spectrum patient companion. Authentication is handled server-side by Vercel and Supabase Auth; browser sessions use HttpOnly cookies.

post.summary: Read a text aloud in its language
post.description: Play again, or read the simplified text. A Piper voice on the clinic's computer (offline). HACKATHON: the audio is generated in memory, never stored or logged.

post.summary: Transcribe a recording (any language), then translate it
post.description: Raw audio body, at most 4 MiB / 60 s. Transcribed offline by the clinic's local brain (faster-whisper, language detected), then translated into `to`. The audio is kept in memory only: never stored, journaled or logged.

200.description: What was heard, and its translation.

503.description: `translation_unavailable`: the local brain or the language model is down. Message: "Translation is not available right now."

415.description: `unsupported_audio`: not webm, ogg, mp4 or wav.

accessCookie.name: clinic_access_token
accessCookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by the Spectrum API. Clients should send credentials for same-origin requests; they should not read this cookie.

roomDeviceCookie.name: spectrum_room_device
roomDeviceCookie.description: HttpOnly room-tablet cookie set by POST /api/room/pair (SameSite=Strict, Secure only behind https). While it is sent, /api/patient/* works on the patient admitted to the tablet's room.

staffBearer.description: Staff token of the clinic server (POST /auth/login); the administrator role is required.

identifier.description: Email address or international phone number.

code.description: Pairing code shown by the care team (case-insensitive).

pairingCode.description: Only in the answer of POST /api/admin/devices.

id.description: Room id of the active clinic map (rooms of kind `room`).

PatientLang.description: ISO 639-1 code. A region suffix (fr-CH) is accepted and dropped.

from.description: Absent: detected by the model. Same as `to`: the text comes back unchanged.

draft.description: Machine output: shown as translated automatically.

simplified.description: false: the text was already plain and comes back unchanged.

heard.description: Transcript and detected language. Empty text: nothing was heard.

translated.description: null when nothing was heard or only the translation step is down. Same language as `to`: the heard text.

PatientSpokenAudio.description: The translation read aloud by a Piper voice on the clinic's computer, or null when no voice speaks the language or the voice failed (the translation never fails because of the voice; the app then uses the browser's voice). HACKATHON: generated in memory for this answer only, never stored or logged.

OriginNotAllowed.description: The request origin is not allowed.

InvalidCredentials.description: The sign-in details are not valid.

InvalidCode.description: The one-time code is invalid or expired.

NotAuthenticated.description: No valid patient session was found.

SignupFailed.description: The account could not be created.

InvalidMood.description: The mood value must be an integer from 1 to 5.

AuthUnavailable.description: The authentication provider is temporarily unavailable.

RoomDeviceNotPaired.description: No valid room-device session (`room_device_not_paired` or `room_device_session_expired`; the cookie is cleared).

NoPatientInRoom.description: The tablet's room has no admitted patient (`no_patient_in_room`).

AdminRequired.description: A staff bearer token with the administrator role is required (`admin_required`).

RoomOperationUnavailable.description: The rooms or the store cannot be read (`room_operation_unavailable`, `auth_unavailable`).
